Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP decisions, Purify assistance, and unmistakable target highlights.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict and Wolves' Den reaction-cue HUD. It includes Ninja Seiton decisions, selected PvP warnings, an opt-in one-attempt Purify helper, and optional focus/current-target highlights with a separate fixed target-information card.
Changelog: Integrated the Super Focus Glow visuals as an optional focus-target module and added a separate cyan current-target highlight. A configurable fixed HUD card can show current-target combat information without attaching anything to nameplates or existing Seiton icons. All three additions are disabled by default; existing Purify and HUD settings are preserved.
